# codec class

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:codecClass`](gmeow-codecClass.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/codecClass>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The capability class of a transform codec (spec §8): what a reader must hold to reverse it — a library (encode, compress) or a key (encrypt).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md) -> [`gmeow:CodecClass`](../classes/gmeow-CodecClass.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:codecClass`](gmeow-codecClass.md) from [`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md) to [`gmeow:CodecClass`](../classes/gmeow-CodecClass.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md), [`gmeow:CodecClass`](../classes/gmeow-CodecClass.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag a transform codec with the capability a reader must hold to reverse it, so the degradation path — unknown-codec vs missing-key opacity — is derivable before decoding.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one class per codec (it is functional) and avoid using it to name the specific algorithm; the class is the capability category, not the codec identity.

### How to use

- Point each [`gmeow:TransformCodec`](../classes/gmeow-TransformCodec.md) at one [`gmeow:CodecClass`](../classes/gmeow-CodecClass.md) (encode, compress, or encrypt); readers use it to decide whether a missing capability yields an unknown-codec or a missing-key [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md).
